screen33-a1.description: the dimmed grey strip to the right of the open drawer (the drawer's scrim); nothing is drawn on it but the dimmed screen underneath
screen33-a1.location: the dimmed grey strip to the right of the open drawer (the drawer's scrim)
screen33-a1.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "Close" - read only to know what to watch for when testing; not used in the verdict
screen33-a1.convention_relied_on: dimmed area outside a drawer or sheet = tap to close it - my reading
screen33-a1.initial_rationale: a dimmed strip beside an open drawer; 'tap the dimmed area to close' is an established mobile convention, though nothing is drawn on it - exemption pending test
screen33-a1.deciding_evidence: tapping the dimmed strip closed the drawer - the dismiss-by-tapping-outside convention held; tested once on screen7-a1 and carried to this identical control

screen33-a2.description: navigation drawer top-left: the word 'ChatGPT' in bold; ImageView whose content_desc says something else

screen33-a2.deciding_evidence: tapping the title word started a new chat - an action nothing about the word predicts; tested once on screen7-a2 and carried to this identical control
screen33-a2.recommendation: replace the title with a labelled 'New chat' control, or add a visible 'New chat' label

screen33-a9.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "Create image" - read only to know what to watch for when testing; not used in the verdict
screen33-a9.initial_rationale: plain rows such as 'Create image', 'Polish writing', repeated 'Create image' - no heading says these are past chats, and they read as commands; four identical rows cannot be told apart
screen33-a9.deciding_evidence: tapping a 'Create image' row opened an old conversation (an existing apple image), not image creation - the wording reads as an action and misleads; tested once on screen7-a13 and carried to this identical control
screen33-a9.recommendation: add a 'Recent chats' heading above the list and show a date or first line so identical titles can be told apart
